scripts.build: npm run build:icons && tsc -b apps/cli && npm run build -w @sysarch/web
scripts.web: npm run build:icons && npm run dev -w @sysarch/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:icons && tsc -b packages/render-svg && tsc -p packages/core/test && tsc -p packages/themes/test && tsc -p packages/layout/test && tsc -p packages/render-svg/test && tsc -b apps/cli && tsc -p apps/cli/test && tsc -b packages/editor && tsc -p packages/editor/test && tsc -p apps/web
